_comment: HunyuanVideo 1.5 720p TEXT-to-video, plus the 1080p SR distill as an optional second stage. Base pass plus the 1080p super-resolution distill, which is the template's optional second stage. Node 63 HunyuanVideo15SuperResolution re-conditions on the start image, 62 upscales the latent to 1920x1080, and 66 SplitSigmas hands the noised half to 71 and the clean half to 73. This writes TWO videos: the 720p base from node 42 and the 1080p from node 76. Slow - measure before reaching for it.
_notes: BASE-ONLY: delete nodes 60-76. They are a self-contained block whose only input is node 35 (the base sampler latent); nothing in 1-42 reads from them. studio/_tools/video_engine_ab.py does exactly this with its --sr flag.
length must be 4n+1. 97 = 4.04s at 24fps, which is also what the LTX 8n+1 length 97 gives, so the two engines are directly comparable at 97.
width/height step 16. Native is 1280x720; 1280x704 matches short.py VID and the LTX motion library exactly.

SHIFT DISCREPANCY, recorded not resolved: the Tencent table (reproduced in the template as a MarkdownNote) says 720p_t2v wants shift 9, but the shipped template wires ModelSamplingSD3 shift 7. This file follows the SHIPPED TEMPLATE (7) because that is the configuration ComfyUI tests. Node 30 is the knob.
The template also states 50 steps is the Hunyuan-team setting and 20 is the ComfyUI speed compromise. Node 34 is the knob.

NOT A BUG, COPIED DELIBERATELY: node 34 BasicScheduler reads the RAW model (2), not the shifted model (30), so ModelSamplingSD3 changes the denoiser but NOT the sigma schedule. The shipped template wires it this way. Rewiring 34 to read 30 changes output; do it as an experiment, not as a cleanup.
cfg 6 means a real negative branch and TWO model evaluations per step. Unlike LTX (cfg-distilled at 1.0) the negative prompt on node 11 is live. The template ships it EMPTY.
EasyCache (template nodes 105/116, threshold 0.2/0.15/0.95) is the speed lever and is omitted here. Add it between 2 and 30/34 if wall-clock matters more than quality.

THE SR STAGE IS MEASURED BROKEN - DO NOT SHIP ITS OUTPUT. Nodes 60-76 run LIVE in this graph and node 76 writes a _sr file on every execution, so the cost is paid whether or not anyone wanted it. A controlled test (samples/hunyuan/compare/sr_stage_isolated.png - the SAME Hunyuan clip with and without the stage) shows the 1920 SR output with a smeared face, lost eyes and a distorted mouth against a sharp 1280 bicubic control. It is not softer, it is destroyed, and destroyed at higher resolution - on the model OWN supported path at the shipped template settings. noise_augmentation 0.15 instead of 0.7 does not rescue it; it swaps the melt for a heavy teal cast with the identity replaced (samples/hunyuan/compare/sr_face_4way.png). Root cause not isolated. Until it is, take the base 1280 output and upscale conventionally, and see the BASE-ONLY note above for how to drop the block.
Both SaveVideo nodes fire: 42 writes the 720p base, 76 writes the 1080p.
If you only want the base, run 41_hunyuan_t2v.json - it is the same graph without this block.

inputs.text: A quiet city street at dusk, neon light shivering in the wet road.
